entities.summary: Denis Ezhov or Denis Yezhov is a Russian professional ice hockey player who currently plays for Gyergyói HK of the Erste Liga. Ezhov was selected by the Buffalo Sabres in the 4th round of the 2003 NHL Entry Draft.
